async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Search for 'Members' using the searchbox on the page
    search_box = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search page")
    await search_box.fill("Members")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for search results to load

    # Step 2: Look for a link with 'Members' in the name
    members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members")
    if await members_link.count() > 0:
        await members_link.click()
    else:
        # If no link found, try to navigate to the Members page via URL
        current_url = page.url
        # Construct the Members page URL based on common GitLab pattern
        if "/edit" in current_url:
            members_url = current_url.replace("/edit", "/-/project_members")
        else:
            members_url = current_url + "/-/project_members"
        await page.goto(members_url)
    
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Locate the invite input field
    invite_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Add members")
    if await invite_input.count() == 0:
        invite_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Invite members")
    if await invite_input.count() == 0:
        invite_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="GitLab member or Email address")
    
    if await invite_input.count() > 0:
        collaborators = ["Jakub K", "Alex Dills", "Alex Hutnik", "Benoît Blanchon"]
        for collaborator in collaborators:
            await invite_input.fill(collaborator)
            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
            # Look for the add button
            add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add")
            if await add_button.count() == 0:
                add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Invite")
            if await add_button.count() > 0:
                await add_button.click()
                await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            else:
                # Fallback: press Enter
                await invite_input.press("Enter")
                await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    else:
        # If no input found, print an error
        print("Could not find invite input field on the Members page.")
